feeds.title: The Enlightened Economist Blog
feeds.description: On The Enlightened Economist Blog, Diane Coyle writes about banks, behavioral capitalism, financial crisis, financial markets, GDP, globalization, inequality, and political economy. Diane is a Bennett Professor of Public Policy at the University of Cambridge and founded the consultancy Enlightenment Economics.

feeds.title: Real-World Economics Review Blog
feeds.description: Go through the Real-World Economics Review Blog and learn more about articles, books, issues, reviews, and much more related to economics.

feeds.title: Marginal Revolution » Books
feeds.description: Take a look through the blog and learn more about books, articles, courses, guides, and more. Marginal Revolution is the blog of Tyler Cowen and Alex Tabarrok, both of whom teach at George Mason University. It began in August of 2003 and there have been new posts daily since that time.

feeds.title: Developing Economics » Book Review
feeds.description: Check out the blog and learn more about resources, series, articles, and more. The Developing Economics blog takes a critical and pluralist approach to the field of Development Economics. It seeks to stimulate debate and reflection on economic development among academics and practitioners from all relevant fields. All critical voices out there are encouraged to submit contributions.

feeds.title: LSE Review of Books Blog
feeds.description: LSE Review of Books publishes reviews of academic books across the social sciences. They aim to facilitate the sharing and exchange of knowledge between experts within and outside of the academy and to open up academic research to increase its impact. They do this by encouraging public engagement with the social sciences through their best-written and most accessible products - books. Visit their blog and learn more about the latest updates, books, guides, articles, reviews, and more.

feeds.title: Booxoul » Economics
feeds.description: Wade through the blog and learn more about books, articles, entertainment, travel, food, services, reviews, and more. Booxoul is one of India's best book blogs since 2017. They aim to give the authors the spotlight they deserve. They have designed numerous packages especially designed for the readers as well as authors.

feeds.title: The Literature Today » Economics
feeds.description: Dive into the blog and learn more about the latest news, issues, articles, education, and more. The Literature Today magazine is amongst the best Indian literary magazine which works towards bringing regional literature and author's work to international platforms. It is constantly promoting indigenous work. Starting its journey in 2018, it has sailed a long way even after facing difficult tornados. Especially during the phase of the pandemic, the e-magazine version has given readers an option to continuously stay connected with literature.

feeds.title: Bookgeeks » Economy
feeds.description: Follow the blog and learn more about books, articles, stories, reviews, and more. Bookgeeks has one of the largest collections of reviews of Indian Business and economics books covering topics as varied as entrepreneurship, success stories, management, business strategy, and sales.
